description: Exposed hydrophobic patch area and contiguity at the ubiquitin Ile44-patch positions in ubiquitin, worm BAG-1 and human BAG1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
def get(u):
    r=S.get(u,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
P={"ubiquitin":get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1UBQ.pdb"),
   "worm BAG-1":get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O44739-F1-model_v6.pdb"),
   "human BAG1":get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q99933-F1-model_v6.pdb")}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
def parse(txt,lo,hi):
    out=[]
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ri=int(l[22:26])
        if not (lo<=ri<=hi): continue
        an=l[12:16].strip(); el=(l[76:78].strip() or an[0])
        out.append(dict(resi=ri,aa=AA3[rn],name=an,el=el,
                        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
    return out
def sphere(n=300):
    i=np.arange(n)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    return np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
SP=sphere(320)
def atom_sasa(atoms,probe=1.4):
    X=np.array([a["xyz"] for a in atoms]); R=np.array([VDW.get(a["el"],1.7) for a in atoms])+probe
    D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None,:],axis=2); out=np.zeros(len(atoms))
    for i in range(len(atoms)):
        nb=np.where((D[i]<R[i]+R)&(np.arange(len(atoms))!=i))[0]
        pts=X[i]+R[i]*SP; acc=np.ones(len(SP),bool)
        for j in nb: acc &= (np.linalg.norm(pts-X[j],axis=1)>=R[j])
        out[i]=4*np.pi*R[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out

SETS={"ubiquitin":(parse(P["ubiquitin"],1,76),      [8,42,44,45,68,70,72], "L8 R42 I44 F45 H68 V70 R72"),
      "worm BAG-1":(parse(P["worm BAG-1"],1,91),    [8,49,51,52,77,79,81], "S8 K49 L51 H52 I77 M79 G81"),
      "human BAG1":(parse(P["human BAG1"],144,230), [151,189,191,192,216,218,220],"S151 K189 I191 F192 M216 I218 K220")}
summary=[]
for nm,(atoms,patch,lab) in SETS.items():
    sa=atom_sasa(atoms)
    sel=[i for i,a in enumerate(atoms) if a["resi"] in patch]
    apolar=[i for i in sel if atoms[i]["el"] in ("C","S")]
    polar =[i for i in sel if atoms[i]["el"] in ("N","O")]
    # contiguity: exposed apolar atoms (>5 A2) of the patch, largest cluster with 6 A linkage
    exp=[i for i in apolar if sa[i]>5]
    X=np.array([atoms[i]["xyz"] for i in exp]) if exp else np.zeros((0,3))
    import networkx as nx
    G=nx.Graph(); G.add_nodes_from(range(len(exp)))
    for a in range(len(exp)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(exp)):
            if np.linalg.norm(X[a]-X[b])<6.0: G.add_edge(a,b)
    comps=sorted(nx.connected_components(G),key=len,reverse=True)
    big=comps[0] if comps else set()
    big_area=sum(sa[exp[k]] for k in big)
    summary.append(dict(structure=nm, patch_residues=lab,
        exposed_apolar_A2=round(sum(sa[i] for i in apolar),1),
        exposed_polar_A2=round(sum(sa[i] for i in polar),1),
        apolar_fraction=round(sum(sa[i] for i in apolar)/max(1e-9,sum(sa[i] for i in sel)),3),
        largest_contiguous_apolar_patch_A2=round(big_area,1),
        n_atoms_in_patch=len(big)))
df=pd.DataFrame(summary)
print("=== Exposed hydrophobic patch formed by the 7 ubiquitin proteasome-surface positions ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# charge at the two rim positions
print("\nRim charge: ubiquitin R42/R72 (Arg,Arg) | worm K49/G81 (Lys,Gly) | human K189/K220 (Lys,Lys)")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.5))
x=np.arange(3); nms=df["structure"]
ax[0].bar(x-0.2,df["exposed_apolar_A2"],0.4,label="exposed apolar (C/S)",color="#E45756")
ax[0].bar(x+0.2,df["largest_contiguous_apolar_patch_A2"],0.4,label="largest contiguous apolar patch",color="#72B7B2")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(nms); ax[0].set_ylabel(r"solvent-accessible area ($\AA^2$)")
ax[0].set_title("Hydrophobic surface at the Ile44-patch positions")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(df["apolar_fraction"]): ax[0].text(i,5,f"apolar frac {v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[1].axis("off")
tbl=[["position","ubiquitin","worm BAG-1","human BAG1"],
     ["L8 (core patch)","Leu8","Ser8","Ser151"],
     ["R42 (rim)","Arg42","Lys49","Lys189"],
     ["I44 (centre)","Ile44","Leu51","Ile191"],
     ["F45","Phe45","His52","Phe192"],
     ["H68 (rim)","His68","Ile77","Met216"],
     ["V70","Val70","Met79","Ile218"],
     ["R72 (rim)","Arg72","Gly81","Lys220"],
     ["C-term diGly","Gly75-Gly76","absent (…K82-N83-A84-L85, domain continues into linker)","absent (…N222-S223-P224, domain continues)"]]
t=ax[1].table(cellText=tbl[1:],colLabels=tbl[0],loc="center",cellLoc="left")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.5); t.scale(1,1.45)
ax[1].set_title("Residues at the ubiquitin proteasome-recognition surface\n(structure-based superposition, TM 0.76 worm / 0.74 human)",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.to_csv("/tmp/patch_area.csv",index=False)
